summary: Closing call to action set as a tri-fold letter (CSS 3D). When it scrolls into view the outer third unfolds, then the other, revealing a letterhead with the brand seal and title, a short note with ticks, and the buttons (or a one-line email form) with an optional sign-off. It unfolds once, then stays a flat paper card with faint fold lines. Fold order, paper tint and seal side are seeded from the brand name. Needs primary_cta or form. Suits accounting, tax, legal and insurance BPO.
